children.value: A QGIS toolbox that automatically symbolizes Esri 10m Land Cover rasters as labeled, colored vector polygons.
A QGIS toolbox that automatically symbolizes
rasters as labeled, colored vector polygons. It supports
map, each in both the GEE and the Original pixel-value scheme.
